purpose: New independent conditional Holding readout, correct native boxes; known A/B/C scenes and held-out initial configurations, not unseen-scene generalization. D samples untouched.

split.train: A12+B12; four targets per color per scene,8 targets per color total
split.lineage: fresh seeds261019500..535, root ids, initialization signatures, near1mm layout and RGB/file hash exclusion. All views/colors/states of root remain together. Original32 and pilot8 engineering only; never merged.
split.claim: C assets known; dev labels used only for preregistered gate then final fixed model evaluation, not hyperparameter selection

collection.sampler: unchanged pilot scene-relative x fractions.18,.5,.82 + jitter±.012, y[-.115,-.055],z.46,yaw±.2; all attempts preserved
controller: same PhysicalOracleV2 source and original bounded retries
collection.trace: same private full per-control trace and synchronous dual-camera capture
collection.failure: no replacement or resampling; retain real negative/unknown labels even on failed controller roots

supervision.Holding: unchanged oracle bilateral finger-family force>0.01N with no other-body support
supervision.validity: same value over previous12 actual controls and at contact-force cutoffs .005,.01,.015; conflicting multi-held states unknown; y remains current .01 definition
supervision.negative: physical stable not-held only; missing visible pixels never negative
supervision.In: frozen labels_v2_1 current geometry+support and boundary mask, private-only
supervision.sync: same-tick RGB/mask/depth and contacts/state before/after exact, flags-off RGB/depth equality
supervision.boxes: block uid by native name; each finger+fixed tip family resolved by native link names; tight visible xyxy, not projected centers
supervision.observability: both target block >=4 pixels and each finger family >=4 pixels needed in that camera; endpoint visibility is necessary proxy, not proof force is visually identifiable. Missing/occluded endpoints are unobservable; contact-force state is not directly RGB-visible.

data_gates.integrity: all synchronous checks and contact/box recomputation pass; no old exact RGB or cross-root split duplicates; source/model hashes fixed
data_gates.eligibility: unchanged physical stability validity AND native endpoints>=4px; controller status is not a model input or a reason to discard valid failure negatives; safety-checked successful-run coverage reported separately
data_gates.on_failure: STOP before features/fits; do not add roots or relax gate

inputs.encoder: cached frozen DINOv2-small, RGB crops only, independent tight box bilinear resize224 align_corners=False; /255, ImageNet normalization, mean all patch tokens384; float32,noAMP,noaugmentation
inputs.projection: same saved data-independent orthonormal384x128 matrix from original precollection design
inputs.pair: same block128 + finger-family union crop128 + geometry5
inputs.box_setting: oracle tight visible native masks, not predicted detector boxes; rectangular RGB crops may include background/occluders. Finger union crop includes space between fingers. Correct-box conditional diagnostic only.
inputs.missing: abstain UNKNOWN; no zero-box filling; all three arms use identical eligible queries; report full physical-valid denominators

comparison.capacity: all one hidden layer, max31 parameter difference (~.36%); different widths and fan-in explicitly disclosed, not identical architecture/initial weights
comparison.initialization: same torch seed261019210+s and defaultLinear rule; all6 initial states saved before acquisition
comparison.attribution: geometry-only is a control for box information. Pair superiority over object alone is not sufficient evidence for visual relation learning; compare pair with geometry and report both seeds/uncertainty, otherwise refrain.

training.loss: BCEWithLogits pos_weight=train eligible negatives/positives; target labels used only as supervision
training.sampler: uniformly choose eligible TRAIN root then uniformly eligible query within root; save shared schedule for all3 arms within seed; numpy seed261019410+s
training.normalization: train eligible feature dimension mean and population std only, floor.05. Pair first128 and geometry last5 use same stats as respective single arms. No dev-dependent statistics.
training.numerics: float32, deterministic Torch CUDA, TF32 off, no AMP or augmentation; serialized GPU lock
training.checkpoint: final600 only, no dev tuning, no earlystop, no seed selection

metrics.precision: TP/(TP+FP), undefined null if no predicted positives
metrics.recall: TP/(TP+FN), undefined null if no actual positives
metrics.balanced_accuracy: (TPR+TNR)/2, undefined null if either actual class absent
metrics.NLL: unweighted binary cross entropy, probability clipped[1e-7,1-1e-7]
metrics.strata: overall,each color,each camera,each root,train anddev separately; confusion/class counts and positive/negative roots alongside every metric
metrics.coverage: full physically valid query denominator; eligible-only metrics; missing endpoints abstain and count as unreturned positives for full-denominator recall
metrics.uncertainty: dev entire-root paired bootstrap2000, seed261019420; same draws for arms and seeds; recompute pooled counts/NLL, percentile95% intervals, report undefined replicates. Paired pair-object and pair-geometry differences per seed. Only12devroots, no independent-view CI.
metrics.identifiability: report identical RGB crop/geometry/feature inputs with opposing physical labels; no dataset removal based on these
metrics.model_claim: no In, no localizer optimization, no world model/SupCon/planning/closed-loop; retain geometry-only control even if it wins

old_outcome: original32 failed gate and pilot8 remain sealed engineering evidence; no merge or reinterpretation
